newsitem.title: USA: Consumers Power Gas continues strong growth.
newsitem.headline: Consumers Power Gas continues strong growth.

text.p: Unprecedented growth of new natural gas service installations continued to fuel the success of Consumers Gas Group, the regulated natural gas utility and storage businesses of CMS Energy Corp's principal subsidiary, Consumers Power Co, the utility said Friday.
Through October, new natural gas service installations were up 19 percent from 1995 totals with 21,000 new customers added, Consumers Power said.
"At this pace, we can expect to reach a record 28,000 total new installations before year's end," said Paul A. Elbert, chief operating officer for the natural gas unit.
This marks the fifth consecutive year the natural gas unit has increased new service installations.
"Natural gas is clearly the dominant fuel of choice for space heating in Michigan," Elbert said.
